description: Gateway routes all client traffic to the Application API.
Gateway validates sessions against the Authentication Service.
Application API reads and writes all business data in the Primary Database.
Application API verifies tokens with the Authentication Service.
Application API stores uploads in File Storage; non-upload endpoints keep working without it.
Application API ships metrics to Monitoring; it runs fine without it.
Authentication Service reads the user directory from the Primary Database and can serve from a local cache with reduced function.
Admin Portal requires the Authentication Service for admin sign-in.
Admin Portal lists users from the Primary Database; a cached view is available.
Backup Service snapshots the Primary Database; existing snapshots remain usable if the database is down.
Backup Service snapshots File Storage; existing snapshots remain usable if storage is down.
